text: new map is not giving me a new map. im pretty sure u just said u fixed this but from my PoV nothing changed at all its just the same map over and over again no matter how many times i press new map
resolution: New Map showed the old map for two proven reasons: (1) the 3D loader pane renders the map-independent baked hmsc.gamefile, so a blank new map (verified 6KB on disk) still showed the old baked city until the next bake — fixed by re-baking the now-empty world on New Map so the loader reloads blank; (2) the autosave intermittently serialized the outgoing map's still-mounted canvas into the incoming file (some new maps came out 420KB+ of the old world) — fixed with a workspace-switch guard in useWorkspace that skips the autosave on the stem-change run. Regression traced to f76513e8a deleting the React build pane. Builds clean; awaiting user verification (restart + New Map → ~5s bake → blank loader).
